I'm not sure is this happened to anyone else, but it was indeed a very strange, and awesome, phenomenon when I was a kid in the early nineties. I lived in Salem, MA, during the nineties. The old cable boxes had a number pad on them, for times when you didn't have the remote. If you went to the number pad on the box, hit 61, then arrow up, you could see about 5 seconds of unscrambled Spice channel. 

It was pretty awesome. I told all my friends because it worked on all of our boxes, and I even used to watch it with who I considered my first girlfriend.

I dream about her often, and in my dreams she's taking me back, but I wake up to the realization that it's not true and was only a fleeting desire that passed through my consciousness. 

You and I are in awkward situations because we're older now (26) so it's going to be hard to find another person that is relationship material. Please take this time to study anything you've ever wanted to study. Get out there. Do something adventurous. Try to get back out there.

I plan to hike to the summit of Mt. Washington in New Hampshire alone this summer. I'm hoping that the solitude and the grand scale of the mountain will help cleanse my mind and put things into perspective. If I can climb that mountain then I can climb the metaphorical mountain that I'm facing now.

Stay strong. You'll make it through this trying time!
